product_metadata.title: Trubetter Nutcracker Christmas Decorations - Outdoor Xmas Decor - Soldier Model Nutcracker Banners for Front Door Porch Garden Indoor Exterior Kids Party (Black red)
features: Package includes–Two banners, Bring the Christmas spirit with these 2 soldier Nutcracker Banners.

Human-friendly design – The bottom of each banner is equipped with two holes. You can use rope to go through the holes and tie the rope to the heavy items, which can not only protect banners from being blown away by the wind but also help the banners keep straight
LIFE SIZE. Measure 14" x 71", fit the door perfect.
Measurement – Made of weather resistant 600D polyester Oxford Fabric.
WARNING – Please wash them with your hands and dry them in the ventilated place. In addition, there may be some wrinkles in the banners; so please iron them gently
